content: Akanksha Bhatt discussed her health policy renewal with insurance agent Anita Sharma. Akanksha inquired about the discounted annual premium of ₹11,875, the coverage dates (April 1, 2026, to March 31, 2027), available payment methods (netbanking, UPI, credit card), and the cancellation policy. Akanksha confirmed she would make the payment today, and Anita agreed to send a secure payment link and activate the policy upon completion.

action_items: Anita Sharma to email the payment link to the customer
Akanksha Bhatt to complete the policy payment today
Anita Sharma to activate the policy upon payment confirmation
